translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Jesucrístona' bliile' Juanna' c̱he diika' zi' gak

content: Na' anjl, beṉ' gayi'na', bkwelle' trompet c̱he'na', na' ble'id' to belj dii bxop xan yabana' jet'an lo yell-liona'. Na' be'gake'ne' xiiṉya c̱he yecha' daa bi chiyoll chido nak zitj.
Na' bsalje' cho'a yecha' daa bi chiyoll chido nak zitj na' bchej ḻo'inna' llen ka c̱he to gorn xen. Na' llenna' daa bchej ḻo'inna' bkwashaan wbilla' na' xan yabana'.
Na' ḻoo llenna' bllesh ba zan inlleb bish'zo na' blliljgakb doxen lo yell-lioni. Na' bene' kwenc̱he gak gad'gakb ka chad' bex̱joni'ka'.
Na' bi bi'e latj bi gongakib yix ga'na' daa de yell-lioni, ni tlish' dii nak shi'a shga', ni tlish' yag, san toz beṉ'ka' bi da' sey c̱he Chioza' loxgue'ka' bzoazi'yaagakb.
Na' bi bi'e latj witgakb ḻegake', san to wzoazi'yaazgakb ḻegake' gay' beo'. Na' gana' god'gakb wlan ka chla gana' chad' bex̱joni'na'.
Na' kat'ka' gak dga, beṉ' yell-lioka' gaklall'gake' guetgake' per bi guetgake'; na' selall'gake' bich soagake' per yeḻ' wita' wxoṉj wkwashiin ḻegake'.
Na' bish'zoka' nakgakb ka kabay ba shaj lo wdiḻ. Na' yic̱hjbka' zoa twej dii nak ka corona de or, na' cho'alaobka' nakan ka cho'alao beṉ'.
Na' yish' yic̱hjbka' nakan ka yish' yic̱hj noolə, na' ḻeybka' nakan ka ḻey bell.
Na' daa nakwgakb nakan de ya na' chkweejan kwerp c̱hebka'. Na' x̱ilbka' chongakan sshag inlleb ka ga za' zan kabay ba ngoyo karret dii zej lo wdiḻa'.
Na' lo xbambka' zoagakan ka ḻew bex̱joni', na' wc̱hingakban kwenc̱he wzoazi'yaagakb beṉ' yell-liona' gay' beo'.
Na' anjla', beena' nak lall' nee yech zitja', chṉabi'e bish'zoka', na' dill' hebrewa' lie' Abadón, na' dill' griegona' lie' Apolión, na' zejin Williayi' Williade.
Na' biyoll yeḻ' zak'zi' necha', per ni chyallj zi c̱hopan.
Na'ch anjl, beṉ' wxopina', bkwell trompet c̱he'na', na' benid' wṉe to beṉ' gana' zoa daa nak ka mes de or gana' chzeygake' yala' daa llia ka ḻozdo'in to to sc̱hin daa zoa lao Chioza'.
Na' golle' anjl, beṉ' wxopina', beena' nox̱' trompeta': ―Bsell anjlka' tap, beṉ'ka' nchej cho'a yao xenna' le Éufrates.
Na' bselle' tapte anjlka', beṉ'ka' nzoe' kwenc̱he witgake' beṉ', na' zi lat'zə ki gok gashjə
beṉ' yell-liona' betgake'. Ḻa' ba nllie' bia' gongake' ka' ka lo gora', lo llana', lo bewaa, na' lo yiza'.
Na' benid' nak c̱hop guiyoa millón soldadka' lliagake' kabay.

Na' ki nak kabayka' ble'do'id' na' beṉ'ka' llia koll'bka': daa nkweej cho'alc̱ho'eka' nakan dii xṉa ka yi'na', na'ch de azul ka yaj wan daa le zafiro, na' dii gush ka bishte daa ne' azufre. Na' yic̱hj kabayka' nakgakan ka yic̱hj bell, na' ḻoo cho'abka' chchej yi' dii nc̱hix̱ azufre na'ch llen.
Zlat'zə ki gok gashjə
beṉ' yell-lioka' witgake' ni c̱he shoṉ yeḻ' zi'ki: yi'na', llenna', na'ch azúfrena' diika' bchej cho'a kabayka'.
Na' kabayka', bc̱hingakb cho'abka' na' xbambka' kwenc̱he betgakb beṉ', ḻa' xbambka' nakgakan ka beḻ, na' yic̱hji daa zoa xbamka' daa nak ka beḻ bzoazi'yaagakan beṉ'.

Na' beṉ'ka' bi biya gueti diiki, bi biyaj bilengakile' dii malka' chongake', ni bi wlej yic̱hjgake' we'la'ogake' dii xiw'ka' na' diika' nongake' de or, de plat, de bronce, na' de yaj na' de yag, diika' bi chle'i ni bi chengakin, ni bi chak sa'gakan.
Ni bi biyaj bilengakile' daa chitgake' beṉ', daa nḻangake' yeḻ' willa'na', ni daa chṉelen ljwellgake', ni daa chzi' chbangake'.

footnotes.text: Zi lat'zə ki gokan gashjə: literalmente la tercera parte.
